posts.title: A Signed JWT Isn't Enough
bullets: Verify the signature with trusted issuer keys and an explicitly allowed algorithm.
Check issuer, audience and expiry against your API's expected values.
Enforce authorization separately: a valid token is not permission for every resource.
posts.takeaway: Trust the issuer. Validate the recipient. Check permissions.
posts.caption:
A valid JWT signature doesn't automatically authorize an API request. Verify trusted keys and algorithms, validate issuer, audience and expiry, then enforce resource-level authorization separately. Test with tokens issued for a different service.
